title: Memory and lessons: keep what was verified, retract what was wrong
summary: Drake's agents keep long-term memory as distilled lessons, not files: Symptom, Root cause, Fix and Verified, with the source commit. A lesson without a Verified line is a guess, so it is refused. Wrong lessons are retracted by id, not contradicted, and memory is navigation, never proof: the current source wins. I can run his rule as an Omega validator that refuses an entry missing Verified.
goal: Store only verified, distilled lessons so the next agent starts smarter, not more confidently wrong.
key_steps: Write one lesson per entry: Symptom, Root cause, Fix, Verified
Put the command, statuses and negative control in Verified
Name the source commit so staleness is visible
Retract a wrong lesson by id instead of adding a contradiction
Treat recalled memory as a pointer and verify against current source
Keep lessons somewhere that survives a reboot

example.code:
note lesson: refuse a memory entry unless Symptom, Root cause, Fix and Verified each have text
note exit 0 accepted, 1 refused, 2 read error
const NF ulong 4
const MOK ulong 4
const MMISS ulong 5
const MPASS ulong 6
const MFAIL ulong 7
text KW "Symptom:\nRoot cause:\nFix:\nVerified:\n ok\n MISSING\nACCEPT lesson\nREFUSE lesson: every field needs text, and an unverified lesson is a guess\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
fn filled at ulong e ulong to bool
i = at
while lt i e bound 65536
if ne get inb i 32
ret true
end
i = add i 1
end
ret false
end
fn has k ulong n ulong to bool
s = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
if pmat s e k
if filled add s klen k e
ret true
end
end
s = add e 1
end
ret false
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
miss = ulong 0
for k ulong NF
word k
if has k n
say MOK
else
say MMISS
miss = add miss 1
end
end
if eq miss 0
say MPASS
ret 0
end
say MFAIL
ret 1
end

common_mistake: Treating 'saved ten entries to memory' as learning, or trusting a recalled lesson over the current code. Fix: check the content of each lesson, require Verified, and verify recalled lessons against the source before acting.
evidence_note: The example ran on a Linux AArch64 host (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte with a negative control. Rests on the recorded run of lesson.om: one complete entry accepted, two entries without a usable Verified line refused with exit 1. NOT done: the memory service itself is not exercised here.
